title: Windows Clone Path Budget
description: The repo must clone on Windows with default Git (core.longpaths unset) into a normal user folder such as C:\Users\abcdefghijklmnopqrst\Documents\semio. Remove or shorten every tracked path whose UTF-16 length plus that prefix exceeds 259 (Win32 MAX_PATH minus the terminating NUL). Ticket trees that embed full source copies are in scope. Add a durable check so new paths cannot exceed the budget. Do not rely on core.longpaths as the fix.
summary: Removed six ticket payload copies that exceeded the Windows checkout budget (longest 271 UTF-16 units) and shortened five fixture directories that CreateDirectoryW rejects under a 20-unit clone root. The tracked tree now tops out at 238 for files and 227 for directories. The cross-platform bootstrap test enforces both limits and passed.
